biography:
Mario Tognoli is a Development Director EMEA & India at Vantage, with 8-10 years of real estate development experience across retail, logistics, and data centers. He is responsible for three sites in Milan, including a 160 MW campus with a CapEx of 
2.2 billion Euros. He has extensive experience in entitlements and permitting, dealing directly with local municipalities and authorities. Mario enjoys being involved in a multinational company and learning from colleagues across different countries. He finds it frustrating to constantly explain the urgency of Italian-specific issues to his London colleagues, who often lack understanding of local jurisdictions and processes.
